items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: The name 'Dick' appears only in the interviewer's question ('Dick, did you go over that list...'). The interviewee does not respond to this address nor mention Dick in their narrative.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, I took a little short boy's place there, and he lost his lip. His lip went bad on him. He couldn't play, and I took him this place. And they featured me maddy good. They featured me a lot there, singing and blowing. I worked there about a year with them, making nice money. I tell you, you ever heard of Junior Cobbs? Oh, yes. He was in the band. He played a lot of different instruments. Yeah, that's him. That's him. Well, he the one come and got me to go with that band. Because I was playing in a…
Well, to get back to those Tiny Parham records, Dick, did you go over that list of which ones? Punch Resort, I remember some of those names. Different ones.

He's in the ensemble on Headhunter's Dream, but the solo, we figured, is Ray Hoffman. Just from this one. What about that last solo? Was there an ending on that? There's an ensemble on that, yes. And that's fun. Yeah, towards the end, yeah. And, uh, and solo trumpet on Stuttering Blues is him, and he's an ensemble trumpet too. He's on Jogo Rhythm, Cuckoo Blues he's on that. Mm-hmm. And Punch is playing second trumpet on Stomping On Down, and they go out, the last chorus. Yeah. And Skaggalag, the other trumpet…
